author: Anika Lubin
body: My headphones won't turn on, even after charging them overnight.

author: Reply
body: Sorry about that — that pattern usually means a faulty cell rather than the charger. I've started a free replacement on order #2847. It ships tonight and arrives tomorrow, and there's nothing to send back.

author: Anika Lubin
body: Oh wow, that was fast. Thank you!
